# Gramlot 0.3.31

## Behaviour changes

- frameGrid routes unprefixed keywords that the grid declares (for example
  `footer`, `rowHeaders`, `sortedBy`, `selectionMode`, `selected_<field>`) to the
  grid; every other keyword goes to the frame. `grid_<name>` and `frame_<name>`
  force the target. Pages that relied on a grid parameter reaching the frame must
  use `frame_<name>`.
- Grids select rows by default (`selectionMode='multi'`); use
  `selectionMode='none'` to keep the previous behaviour. A frameGrid with its own
  `datapath` publishes the current row to `.selectedId`.
- Grid column keywords other than the declared attributes and
  `formula_<identifier>` are rejected at authoring time in Python and JavaScript.

## Grid

- Row formulas: `formula` with `formula_<name>` parameters (`^` triggers, `=`
  reads), `calculated`, `hidden`; specials `#`, `+=field` and `%=field`.
  Arithmetic formulas run through a parser (numbers and Decimal) and also work
  from a `structpath` struct; other formulas compile like inline expressions.
  Formulas recalculate when an edit is committed, never on drafts.
- `#` and `+=` are computed per grid on its visible rows (1..n); while a filter is
  active they are marked with `filtered-numbering`.
- Footer totals: `footer`, `totalize`, `footer_value`, `footer_format`; totals are
  published to `.totalize.<field>` also without a visible footer, and are null
  when they cannot be computed.
- Row selection: `selectionMode` none | single | multi with mouse and keyboard;
  legacy publication paths `selectedId`, `selectedIndex`, `selectedLabel`,
  `selectedPkeys`, `selectedRowidx`, `selectedNodes`, `selectedRowData`,
  `selected_<field>`, plus `.selectionLength` and `onSelectedRow`.
- Formula results, totals and selection paths are not editing-session changes.

## frameGrid tools

- `export` (CSV, JSON, TYTX, XML and XLSX of the visible rows; restrict with
  `export="csv,json"`), `printRows`, `advancedTools` (a "…" menu with the
  line-number toggle).
- For editable grids: `addrow` (with `addrow_defaults`), `duprow`, `delrow` and
  `gridsemaphore`.
- XLSX uses write-excel-file 4.1.1 (MIT), loaded on first use.

## Page store

- `PageStore.source_builder()` returns a builder with the collections of the
  page, loaded by the server as for `@source` methods, for server-authored Source
  such as chat replies.

## Repository

- The full test suite runs only on request: by manual dispatch or from
  `Publish release` with `full_tests`.

## Verification

Local qualification: 1923 JavaScript tests passed; 445 Python tests passed with
5 expected failures, and the 18 collection-preparation tests passed on Node 22.
The chart collection bundles are rebuilt from the current sources.
